Mogami Heavy Industries - Offshore Plant
Mogami Heavy Industries - Offshore Plant Interior
Zuiun
Major Kai,@I apologize that my children overstepped@their bounds like that.
Not at all. I hear the Soul Saber's fighting@kept the damage to the city to a minimum.
Your son and daughter should be arriving@at Yakumo Base about now.@However, the questioning will likely be held at Izu.
Izu...?@You're welcome to keep the Soul Saber,@but the children...
I intend to press my superiors to treat this@incident as voluntary cooperation.
Then, as for the unauthorized combat...
The G-Compatible Kaiser was@on the scene as well.@I expect it'll be overlooked as a special case.
Th-Thank you very much.@I'm sure this has taught them both a lesson.@I'll have them quit as test pilots.
...They do seem to have a knack for it, though.
No, no. It'd be outrageous if they thought@they could fight like the <Special Tactics@Instructor Unit> or the <Steel Dragons>.
Now... the item you recovered. Anything unusual?@I mean, any sign that it might@reactivate?
No, nothing in particular. The pilot's still comatose.
I've heard the report, but...@is it really not of Earth origin?@There was a human aboard, wasn't there?
The unknown is shaped like an aircraft,@not much different from those on Earth, but...
Its power source uses unknown technology,@and parts of the machine bear markings@not in any Earth language.
Also, the pilot looks like a human woman,@but we have no proper medical facilities here,@so I can't tell you more.
...Is she really human?
In appearance, at least.@We have no proper medical facilities here,@so I can't tell you any more than that.
I see.@As I believe Izu has also told you, please keep@the unknown confidential from all but those involved.
Understood. I haven't told the children either.
Right now, our response is delayed due to massive@comm outages and the fighting in Sapporo, but...
I'll send my men your way as soon as possible.@Please bear with us a little longer.
Understood.
Earth Federation Army - Yakumo Base
...So in the end, all three are left outside?
Yeah.@Apparently this base doesn't have a hangar@that can fit a <Super Robot> over 50 meters tall.
Well, the Federation Army's main units are@20-meter-class <Personal Trooper>s and@<Armored Module>s, after all.
Akimi, is our questioning@going to be at this base?
Probably, I'd guess.
Melua
Melua, like my big brother said, you don't@need to worry. Major Kai Kitamura, who knows@Shoko and the others, is coming.
No, um...@So much has happened, I'm just tired...
(Of course...@She lost her mom and dad,@and people she knew...)
Katia
...! An alarm?!
Announcement
Attention, all Yakumo Base personnel. Mobile weapons@believed to be the <Zovorg> have appeared at a@<Mogami Heavy Industries> offshore plant off Shakotan.
Units from Izu Base are currently en route@to the area. Scramble crews, stand by for@immediate launch for a second intercept. Repeat...
Hey, the Mogami offshore plant...?
That's where my old man is!
Wh-Why would aliens target@Mogami's offshore plant?!
How should I know?!
...They said units from Izu Base are on their way.@Does that mean Major Kai and the others?
If the units here are on standby, then Akemi!@We're taking the Soul Saber to Dad!
I want to as well, but how are we@supposed to get to an offshore plant?!@It can't fly on its own!
Kota! Carry the Soul Saber with the@Compatible Kaiser, like you did before!
Sure, leave it to me.
B-Big brother?!@Aren't we supposed to stay here?!
Like heck!@If I abandon a guy who wants to save his old man,@I ain't much of a man!
Kota...!
I brought the Gran-whatsit all the way here,@so I did what Major Kai asked!
But even if we can go, the Soul Saber@is supposed to stay here...
Shut it, I've made up my mind! I'll go alone if I have to!
Ugh, fine, fine, I get it!@I'm going too! Without the G-Thundergate,@the Compatible Kaiser can't even fly!
Thanks, you two!@Touya, you guys stay here!
Y-Yeah...
All right, let's hurry!
Right!
(Akimi and Akemi are fighting again,@for their father...)
(But I...)
Attention, <Zovorg> mobile weapons!@This is an unarmed civilian plant!@Withdraw immediately!
(The Ariard should have fallen around here...@There's no reading, but that facility is suspicious.)
(If I don't recover it soon, a scolding from@Lady Reggiane will be the least of my worries.)
All units.@We'll use force to seize and search the offshore facility.
Grr!@This plant has no strategic value...
(Could they be after that unknown?!)
(This reading...)
We're going in, Akimi!
Yeah!
Landing complete!@We beat the Federation Army here!
Guess you were right, Akimi.@Comin' here was the right call.
Dad, we came to save you!
You idiot!@I never asked you to do any such thing!!
Wh-What kind of thing is that to say?!
You're only a test pilot!@Don't get cocky just because you've seen combat!@You were simply lucky!
Shut up, is this really the time for that?!@The enemy's right in front of us!
An amateur butting in will only get hurt!@Stay out of this!
What're you talking about?!@There's nowhere to stay out of!
Come on, don't argue at a time like this!
I know!@I'm cutting off the comm with the plant!
Hey, you! Wait!
Geez, Dad... Just sit back and watch!
Akimi, I'll take the front!@You just back me up from atop the plant!@And don't go jumpin' in the sea!
Got it!
(Hmph, interceptors appeared sooner than expected.@With only two, I can handle them.)
Oh, this ID code...
The <Special Tactics Instructor Unit>...@Arado and the others are here!
Eleve 3 to all units.@We're cleared to shoot down the Zovorg machines.@Spread out and take them down individually.
Eleve 4, roger.
Eleve 5, roger!
Eleve 6, roger that too!
Hey, Hugo.@Do you think the enemy's after that unknown?
It's very possible, but save the guessing for later.@And don't forget that the unknown@is classified.
Of course.
Huh, where are Major Kai and the others?
The Major and Lieutenant Lamia went to Yakumo Base.
Actually, they went to pick you guys up, but...
Why are you here?
Well, y'see... a man asked me for a favor.
Huh? What do you mean?
The Falken, the Bilgear, the Raptor...@Whoa, the real things...
That super robot... it's the one the Instructors@are scheduled to evaluate...
That's enough talk. We're attacking.
(That unit... If they were already headed here,@then the Ariard...)
(Either way, I'll have to destroy them.)
Tch, in an unfamiliar machine...!@But I've found a lead.
Ah, he ran!
No need to pursue.@We'll carry out our original mission.@Aqua, call for the transport.
Got it.
We somehow held them off...
(The reason they attacked here...@Does it have to do with that sleeping beauty?)
I won't let you lay a finger on the plant!@I'll show my old man that the Soul Saber@can fight!
That one moves differently from the others...?!
(A large machine not in our data...@If I'd had the Leonysis, this wouldn't be a problem.)
(That machine matches our data.)
Roa
That machine's pilot isn't a bioroid.
Then I'll grab him and make him spill@what the heck he came here for!
If the Zovorg showed up here,@does that mean the unknown is theirs?
Maybe, but we can't look into that@until we drive them off.
(They match our data too...@and they're flagged as dangerous.)
That one's manned.
Probably. Its movements waver a lot.
(Is this mission so important they'd@send in a human commander?)
(I can't recover the Ariard without eliminating them...)
The war with the Zovorg was supposed to be over...!
(Is the fallen unknown so important that they'd@send mobile weapons to recover it...?)
(If they came to collect the Ariard,@has it already been recovered...?)
I can't believe we ran into the Zovorg here!
(Surely they didn't come here@with that group's help...)
I'm Lieutenant Hugo Medio of the Far East Command's@<Special Tactics Instructor Unit>.
Likewise, Lieutenant Aqua Centrum.
I'm Zuiun Akatsuki, president and CEO of@<Mogami Heavy Industries>. Thank you for the rescue.@Thank you too, Kota and Shoko.
Nah, don't mention it.
(Though I'm sure Major Kai's going to yell at us later...)
...And why did you two come here as well?!@Akimi, Akemi!
What?! That's how you react to us?!
After we rushed all the way out here!
I told you, I didn't ask for it.@Your job is to be test pilots,@not to take part in real combat.
W-Well, that's true, but...@we couldn't just sit still.
Hmph. How rash.
Wh-What?! We were worried about you!@Why are we the ones getting yelled at?!
...Isn't it because he feels the same as you?
Huh?
Just like you two were,@President Akatsuki is worried about you.@Real combat isn't like a mock battle, after all.
Ugh...
It's because he's worried.@I don't think people get angry@over someone they don't care about.
How should I know that...
Heh, you'll understand someday.@I did.
President Akatsuki.@We'll return as soon as this is settled,@but your son and daughter and the Soul Saber...
I understand.@I'm sorry for causing you@extra trouble.
Trouble? I'll just carry it back with the Kaiser.
You two had better head back to Yakumo Base first.@Major Kai is furious.
Ugh, but we ended up protecting this place,@so what's the big deal...
Save your excuses for the Major.
Oh well... Let's go, big brother!
Y-Yeah... I bet he's gonna lecture us for hours.
Akimi, Akemi.@Prepare the Soul Saber for transport.@Strictly as test pilots.
Y-Yeah...
...I'm sorry for all the trouble, Lieutenant Aqua.
No, I'm the one who stuck my nose in...
No, no, it's quite all right.@We fathers are just no good with words.
That's not true.@It's better than being absurdly overprotective.
Could it be that your father...
By the way, President Akatsuki.@As for why the <Zovorg> targeted this place...@any ideas besides the unknown?
No, none.
Then one more question.@Do you think the unknown belongs to the Zovorg?
This is only my opinion, based on our investigation...
But it's most likely from a different alien race.
(If not the Zovorg, then the <Balmar>?@Or...)
So where's that unknown thing?@It's already been pulled out, right?
Hey, you shouldn't say things so carelessly.
Not everyone on this plant@knows about the unknown.
O-Oh, right...
Ah...
So you're the Soul Saber's test pilots.
Yes, that's right.
I'm Seolla Schweizer,@Special Tactics Instructor Unit.
I'm Latune Subbota...
I'm Arado Balanga. Nice to meet ya.
(I read online that the Special Tactics Instructor@Unit had some young members, but...@they really are about our age.)
I'm Akemi Akatsuki.@And this is my twin brother, Akimi.
Huh, so you're the opposite of Raul and Fiona.
The opposite? Are they twins too?
Yeah, we fought together in the <Shura Revolt>@and <The Sealing War>.
By the way, the Special Tactics Instructor Unit@is under Izu Base, right?
Yes. You know your stuff.
So why are you in Hokkaido?@You didn't come straight from Izu after the alert.@Were you headed here for some other reason?
(He's pretty sharp...)
Sorry, but I can't answer that.
Military secret, huh?
No comment on that either.
(...That's as good as half an answer.@The Zovorg showing up here wasn't a coincidence...@and of course Dad must know why.)
